verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents broad first-party API coverage of admin functions: the Admin SDK handles users, devices, alerts, SSO and email routing, and audit and usage reports, and Apps Script can automate Admin console tasks. Nothing in the evidence claims or demonstrates full UI parity. Many UI features shown, such as Context-Aware Access policies, 2SV enforcement and Meet note settings, are documented only as console workflows. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, evidence that security-policy features like Context-Aware Access and 2SV are API-configurable, end-user app (Gmail/Docs/Meet) feature parity evidence, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Anyone can use Apps Script to automate Admin console tasks in a web-based, low-code environment.
Manage single sign-on (SSO) and email routing settings for your account.
View and manage Google Workspace alerts for your account.
Retrieves a paginated list of either deleted users or all users in a domain.
The Admin SDK Reports API lets administrators of enterprise domains to view the audit and usage reports of their domain.
